newsitem.title: USA: Zonagen begins Phase III Vasomax trials.
newsitem.headline: Zonagen begins Phase III Vasomax trials.

text.p: Zonagen Inc said it began the first of two U.S. Phase III clinical trials for Vasomax, the company's oral therapeutic for male impotency.
The company said this is the first of two pivotal U.S. trials. The second Phase III clinical trial is expected to begin later this month.
In this trial, 360 patients have been enrolled at 14 sites. The second trial is expected to enroll 540 patients at 20 sites.
The trials are being conducted by Zonagen in connection with Affiliated Research Centers, and PPD-Pharmaco is monitoring the study.
Zonagen said it hopes to submit the results of these clinical trials to the U.S Food and Drug Administration in June, as part of a New Drug Application.

Vasomax is formulated in a proprietary, fast-dissolving oral tablet yielding a plasma concentration of phentolamine, its active ingredient. Zonagen has received a domestic patent and has filed international patent applications on the Vasomax formulation.
